provenance: Each fixture is loaded into a new 0600 journal.sqlite3 in a private 0700 state directory, then the Python Journal runs the steps; see README.md for the step vocabulary

sqlite_master.name: metadata
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE TABLE metadata (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

sqlite_master.name: requests
sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TABLE requests (
            request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, operation TEXT NOT NULL,
            state TEXT NOT NULL, response TEXT, delivered INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            request_hash TEXT, created_at REAL NOT NULL, updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
            delivered_at REAL, response_expired INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        )

sqlite_master.name: delivered_history
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE INDEX delivered_history ON requests(delivered,delivered_at)

sqlite_master.name: project_assignment_delivered_v1
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE INDEX project_assignment_delivered_v1 ON requests(delivered_at) WHERE operation='project_assignment' AND delivered=1 AND state!='running'

sqlite_master.name: analytics_delivered_reads
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE INDEX analytics_delivered_reads ON requests(delivered_at) WHERE operation='analytics_read' AND delivered=1 AND state!='running'

sqlite_master.name: terminal_delivered_reads
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE INDEX terminal_delivered_reads ON requests(delivered_at) WHERE operation='terminal_snapshot' AND delivered=1 AND state!='running'

sqlite_master.name: archive_delivered_reads
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE INDEX archive_delivered_reads ON requests(delivered_at) WHERE operation='archive_list' AND delivered=1 AND state!='running'

sqlite_master.name: file_delivered_reads
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE INDEX file_delivered_reads ON requests(delivered_at) WHERE operation='file_read' AND delivered=1 AND state!='running'

sqlite_master.name: attachment_delivered_reads
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE INDEX attachment_delivered_reads ON requests(delivered_at) WHERE operation='attachment_read' AND delivered=1 AND state!='running'

sqlite_master.name: journal_operation
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE INDEX journal_operation ON requests(operation)

sqlite_master.name: delivered_reads
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE INDEX delivered_reads ON requests(delivered_at) WHERE operation='inspect' AND delivered=1 AND state!='running'

sqlite_master.name: mutation_retention
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE INDEX mutation_retention ON requests(delivered_at) WHERE operation!='inspect' AND delivered=1 AND state!='running' AND response IS NOT NULL AND response_expired=0
